source: JPL DE440 (de440.bsp, sha256 a4ce9bf9b3282becc9f4b2ac3cebe03a2ae7599981aabd7265fd8482fff7c4b5) through jplephem 2.24 for the geometry; the reductions and the ayanamshas of the Swiss Ephemeris 2.10.03

definitions.tithi: apparent geocentric Moon less Sun, true equinox of date, at a multiple of 12 degrees; TT
definitions.karana: the same at a multiple of 6 degrees; TT
definitions.nakshatra: the Moon's apparent longitude less the true ayanamsha at a multiple of 13 deg 20 min; TT
definitions.yoga: the Moon's and the Sun's apparent longitudes less twice the true ayanamsha at a multiple of 13 deg 20 min; TT
definitions.sankranti: the Sun's apparent longitude less the true ayanamsha at a multiple of 30 degrees; TT
definitions.sunrise: the geocentric altitude of the Sun's centre at -34' + horizontal parallax (centre_refraction) or less the semidiameter of 959.23" at 1 AU too (upper_limb_refraction), apparent places of the true equator and equinox, Greenwich apparent sidereal time; rows of [day index from 1 January local, UT1, the Delta T in seconds the Sun's place was read under, seconds of sunrise per second of Delta T]

de440_shift.what: the largest move from the .se1 files' astrometric place to DE440's over every place recorded
